exercises.instruction: Find eight mistakes in this dialogue and correct them.
items: A: What do you think for this idea to stop free eye tests?
B: I think it's not a good idea. In my meaning, people will just stop going to the optician's.
C: I'm afraid but I total disagree.
A: Yes, it's written in one newspaper that most people are happy to pay for an eye test.
B: You can be right, but don't you think it's more complicated than that?
C: Yes, I'm agree, that's true.

exercises.instruction: Organise sentences a–f into a logical dialogue.
items: a As far as I'm concerned, that's long enough.
b Yes, you could be right about education, but don't forget they've only been in power for six months.
c Why's that?
d How do you feel about the new government?
e Well, I don't think they've done much to improve schools.
f Personally I don't think they're any better than the last one.

exercises.instruction: Rewrite the sentences using the word on the right. Start with the words you are given. The meaning must stay the same.
items: 2 Well, in my opinion, more people should go to university. Well, .............................................................................. CONCERNED

exercises.instruction: Complete the dialogue with suitable phrases.
items: B: Well, (2) .............................. , I find it quite comfortable and quick.
A: I (3).............................. that it's quick, but it does seem a bit expensive.
B: I agree with you to (4): .............................................. , but it's still cheaper than in many countries.
A: Really? But (5) .............................................. the newspapers, this government doesn't spend nearly enough on public transport.
